text:
kai: quick update  ran v5-int4-longdoc canary on the long-doc route at 2% for 3h. latency p95 -90ms, p50 -30ms, cost/tokens -20%. concerning signals: long-doc MRR -1.9% (p≈0.04), anchor-concordance set-L -1.6% (p≈0.03), hallucination +0.3pp. proposing a capacitor-style anchor gate that combines slice sample-size, anchor concordance, and global MRR before hard rollback. cc @elaine @vik

ellaine: can you share the simple decision rule you have in mind? curious about min samples because long-doc anchors are noisy.

kai: thinking aloud: require min_tokens=200k for slice before any automatic rollback. decision rule: if (anchor_drop_pct >= 1.5% AND anchor_pval < 0.05) AND (global_MRR_drop >= 1.0% over same window) -> hard rollback. else if (anchor_drop_pct >= 1.5% AND anchor_pval < 0.05 AND global_MRR_drop < 1.0%) -> shadow 24h + extended eval. also add a KL divergence check on top-20 tokens for anchors: if KL>0.1 AND anchor_drop>=1% -> urgent flag.

vik: I like the capacitor idea. add smoothing: require two consecutive windows (3h each) and use Bayesian credible interval for MRR instead of just p-values to avoid small-sample noise. and cap per-slice ramp to max 5% if slice traffic <1%.

kai: agreed. here's the gate snippet (plain text):

"anchor_capacitor_rule: min_tokens=200000; window=3h; consecutive_windows=2; anchor_threshold=1.5; anchor_pval=0.05; global_mrr_threshold=1.0; kl_threshold=0.1; max_slice_ramp_pct=5; cooldown_minutes=90; jitter_pct=10"

ellaine: ops question: what happens if anchor drop is significant but global MRR improves (weird but possible)? prefer to auto-hold + shadow rather than rollback. global regressions should be the ultimate trigger.

vik: agreed. let's also require an elevated-hallucination bypass: if hallucination_increase >=0.5pp -> immediate rollback regardless of anchor vs global math.

kai: good call. ops-bot/canary-bot: can you schedule a 48h shadow for the long-doc anchors at 3% and persist traces until 500k tokens? also record top-20 token KL profiles every 6h.

canary-bot: scheduled: 48h shadow started for thread 5532109876 at 3% traffic. trace capture target 500k tokens; KL profile cadence 6h. will post interim 12h summary. link: https://ci.redwood-inference/smoke/5532109876

ellaine: action items: (1) implement anchor_capacitor_rule in the canary promoter, (2) add Bayesian credible-interval smoothing with window=2, (3) add dashboard panels for anchor-concordance, top-20 KL, and slice token counts, (4) set alert: anchor-concordance drop >=1.5% AND tokens>=200k -> notify #eng-ml and pause any automatic promotion.

vik: plus add randomized promotion schedule +/-10% and cooldown 90m after rollback to prevent oscillation.

kai: will push the promoter change and the dashboards. i'll post the 12h shadow summary here. thanks all.
